summary: Independently reviewed and accepted the bounded value-owned Go lifecycle fixture, native replay, and React/DOM compiler output. Active cancellation code uses ordinary append in Grandchild/Child/Parent order; tests cover all eight pending masks, sibling preservation, stale/duplicate replies, reordered requests, three generations, and existing counter reuse. Independent audits verified all four request-ID guards, every subtree generation guard, typed uint64 AppIR fields, and every emitted output file hash. This acceptance does not include mounted browser effect delivery or generic Manager compilation.
